text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)――Welcomed by 
thunderous cheers, the Umamusume driving 
today's Twinkle Series stepped out into 
the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and the others burn with 
fighting spirit toward the great stage 
that lies ahead— and toward their rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching over them are Special Week—the 
"Supreme Commander of Japan" from the 
Golden Generation—and the Grand Prix 
Umamusume, Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Autumn of the Senior Year. A race that 
would become a turning point for Narita 
Top Road was about to begin.
